params.body: Four octaves of low-frequency noise break the region into broad, uneven tears. Finer noise adds small bites. Noise stays anchored to the wall UV plus the seed: moving the region reveals new tears and backing patches, and returning to a position restores its pattern. Resizing the region keeps the noise scale fixed. The noise field has no polar seams.
params.title: 05 · Noise-torn boundary

params.body: An independent noise field controls how much backing is exposed: mostly thin frayed edges with occasional wider peeled patches. The backing sits between two irregular boundaries. Width stays in UV units as the region changes size. The height profile lifts the inner lip and settles back onto the wallpaper.
params.title: 06 · Exposed paper backing

params.body: All three shapes use these coordinates. Tear region sets XY center / ZW full size; Tear amount scales the opening. Shape selection happens only in group 04.
params.title: 00 · Shared placement

params.body: Height-derived normals shade the lifted inner lip. A short exponential shadow falls into the opening, strongest under the wider lifted patches. It fades with edge lift and disappears when the tear closes. No repeated flap shapes or painted shadow atlas; the relief is a flat-material illusion.
params.title: 08 · Lift and contact shadow

params.body: OUTPUT: the rightmost Combine → Vec3. Connect it to Split → In in group 04, replacing the current wire. Exact rounded-box distance in wall UV units. Tear region controls size and position; Box corner radius is a fraction of the smaller side, clamped to 0–0.5. Zero gives square corners.
params.title: 03 · ROUNDED BOX SDF — ready to connect

params.body: OUTPUT: the rightmost Combine → Vec3. Connect it to Split → In in group 04, replacing the texture wire. Uses Tear region width/height for the ellipse and Tear amount for its size. The gradient gives an approximate distance near the edge. No image or SDF texture settings are needed.
params.title: 02 · ELLIPSE SDF — ready to connect

params.body: SWAP HERE: connect any shape group’s final Combine → Vec3 to this Split → In. One wire replaces the active shape AND its distance limits. X = distance (negative inside, zero edge, positive outside), Y = outside range, Z = inside range; all in wall UV units. The texture is connected by default. The remaining material always reads this group.
params.title: 04 · CONNECT ONE SHAPE HERE

params.body: OUTPUT: the rightmost Combine → Vec3. Connect it to Split → In in group 04. X carries signed distance; Y/Z carry the outside/inside distance limits. Red channel: white inside, black outside, boundary 0.5. SDF range = pxrange / width for square maps. Clamped sampling prevents repeats. This is the default source; the other two outputs are unplugged.
params.title: 01 · TEXTURE SDF — default connection

params.body: Wallpaper image covers the intact surface; Inner wall image fills the opening. Both follow the mesh UV, with all surface detail supplied by the images. Transparent pixels reveal Wallpaper color or Exposed wall color. Empty image slots use the editor’s neutral gray. The paper backing uses Paper underside color with edge lift and contact shading.
